title: Time bound for computing the input length in binary
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $e$, the fixed finite Turing machine `lengthBitsTM` computes, on every word $w$, the binary representation of $|w|$ within $\bigl((C+1+5e)2^e+45\bigr)(|w|+1)^{e+1}$ steps.
caveat: The supplied statement refers to `lengthBitsTM`, but its definition is not included, so the machine itself cannot be described more explicitly.
